The '''Superflare''' was a modified [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S swoop]] produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Due to its oversized [[autoblaster]], the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]{{'s}} handling was significantly impacted.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
